{{Quote|Terminate! Terminate!|A bomb droid's battle cry|<ref name="SW:OW" />}}
'''Bomb droids''' were a type of [[Droid/Legends|droid]]. Bomb droids were designed to seek out a target and detonate once near enough,<ref name="Star Wars: Obi-Wan: Prima's Official Strategy Guide">[[Star Wars: Obi-Wan: Prima's Official Strategy Guide|''Star Wars: Obi-Wan'': Prima's Official Strategy Guide]]</ref> and as such were basically a bomb on legs. They uttered a battle cry as they charged a target. Bomb droids were used by the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] onboard their [[Flagship/Legends|flagship]] [[Saak'ak/Legends|''Saak'ak'']] and on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] during the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Invasion of Naboo]]<ref name="SW:OW" /> in the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]].<ref name="The New Essential Chronology">''Star Wars: Obi-Wan'' itself refers to its events taking place during the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Invasion of Naboo]]. ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' establishes that the invasion happens in [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]].</ref> They exploded on impact if subject to a [[Telekinesis/Legends#Force push|Force push]] by a [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]], and could also be destroyed by a [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] shot, [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] strike, or explosion.<ref name="SW:OW" />

==Behind the scenes==
Bomb droids appear in the [[2001]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: Obi-Wan (video game)|Star Wars: Obi-Wan]]'' and received an entry in [[Star Wars: Obi-Wan: Prima's Official Strategy Guide|the game's strategy guide]]. They attack the player in several missions during the Naboo portions of the game. Two bomb droids [[Capture of Theed/Legends|escort]] the [[Queen/Legends|Queen]] during an altered scene from [[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''The Phantom Menace'']].
